problem: Why does every new model/tool pairing require another adapter?
principle: MCP standardizes capability/context exchange. The host owns the model and policy; clients connect; servers wrap domain services rather than replacing them.
check: Has generating read_quote arguments already sent an MCP request?
answer: No. The host maps an authorized model proposal to a client request; generation is not execution.
diagram_title: Host, client, server and domain backend
scope: Baseline: MCP 2026-07-28 and official Python SDK 2.3.0; legacy handshakes are labeled separately.
